newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat closes lower on CBOT fund selling.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat closes lower on CBOT fund selling.

text.p: Massive fund selling in CBOT soft red winter wheat futures, which drove that market to new contract lows in the March and May, pressed KCBT hard red winter wheat futures to a lower close, traders said.
"We were hit pretty hard especially when Chicago made the new lows," a trader said.
Talk India and Egypt would not be purchasing U.S. wheat over the weekend and an estimated 20 million to 30 million bushel sale by funds in Chicago hit wheat futures markets Friday.
There was fund selling in KCBT wheat too.
"Rosenthal (Rosenthal Collins) sold five million bushels of March," the trader said.
KCBT hard red winter wheat futures closed 2-1/2 to 8-3/4 cents per bushel lower, with March down 8-3/4 at $4.03-1/4.
